policy_en: A freeze is pre-print only if the GitHub commit time is before the official release. CPI 11 Sep and NFP 4 Sep freezes were internal; first public copy is the 14 Sep 10:20 snapshot (commit c32856a). Later snapshots on 14–16 Sep are additional public pre-print freezes for FOMC 15–16 Sep. After the FOMC print (+25bp), this publish appends a result snapshot without rewriting freeze files. Countable freeze-vs-print starts at FOMC 15–16 Sep.
policy_zh: 只有 GitHub commit 时间早于官方公布，冻盘才算事前。CPI 9/11 和非农 9/4 的冻结当时只在内部；第一次公开是 9/14 10:20 快照（commit c32856a）。9/14–16 的后续快照是 9/15–16 FOMC 的追加事前公开冻结。FOMC 公布（+25bp）后，本次只追加结果快照，不改写冻结文件。可计分的冻盘对公布从 9/15–16 FOMC 开始。
